opennyai_summary.decision:
Applicant seeks anticipatory bail in FIR/Case Crime No.252 of 2023 dated 18.05.2023, under
Sections 420, 120-B Ipc and Sections 3/21(3) of The Banning Of Unregulated Deposit Schemes Act,
2019 and Sections 4/5 of The Prize Chits And Money Circulation Schemes (Banning) Act, 1978 and
Section 3 of The Banning Of Unregulated Deposit Schemes Act, 2019, Police Station Patel Nagar,
District Dehradun.
It is argued that the co-accused having similar role have already been granted bail.
4. Let State file objections within four weeks.
5. List on 04.06.2024.
6. Having considered, as an ad-interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail subject to his furnishing personal bond, to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer ("AO"), subject to the following:-
(i) The applicant shall not approach in any manner, whatsoever, any of the witness in the case.
(ii) He shall cooperate with the investigation.
(iii) He shall not leave the country without prior permission of the concerned court.
(iv) He shall deposit his passport with the AO.
The passport may only be returned by the order of the court concerned.
In case, if the applicant does not have passport, he shall give an undertaking to that effect to the AO.
(v) The applicant shall also give an undertaking on (i), (ii) & (iii) above.
